thread:
maya: Quick sync 1 4c5 Were rolling a launch ripple next Tue: benchmark blog + webinar. Need final post schedule for X (main + follow thread), LinkedIn (long post + 2 follow-ups), hero assets, and SDR routing for inbound. Goal: amplify product wins + demo RSVP.

rui: Proposed publish windows: X main at 10am PT, X follow thread 10:05am, LinkedIn long post 11am PT. We should stagger to catch both morning traffics. Thoughts?

sam: Copy drafts attached in the shared doc. Two X hooks (metrics-led vs product-led). Using UTM template so we can track per-channel + per-creative.

```
utm_template: ?utm_source={channel}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-ripple-05-2026&utm_content={variant}
X_metric: "See how Redwood cut inference cost 3x on real workloads. Join our live benchmark walkthrough."
X_product: "Shipping LLMs that behave: latency SLOs, caching, and routing in production. Live demo + Q&A."
```

anya: Asset status: thumbnails + hero stills done. Need a motion gif for X thread opener (square 1080x1080). I'll drop links to staging bucket by EOD Mon. Also prepping variant image overlays with CTAs (Register / Watch Demo).

kevin: SDR routing: All signups should land in HubSpot list "Launch Ripples May 2026" and tag lead_owner=pool-sdr-team. @sdr-bot can you confirm forms + webhook mapping? Also we should create an internal attribute `social_variant` so we know which creative drove the lead.

sdr-bot: Confirmed. Webhook -> HubSpot mapping ready. Field mapping: email, name, company, utm_source, utm_content -> social_variant. Test webhook run scheduled Tue 09:00am PT.

maya: Engagement playbook: assign first response to social-ops (within 1 hour), hot leads (requested demo or left phone) escalate to SDR queue immediate. We also need two canned replies per channel to reply to thread comments and to DM signups. Sam/KeviN please add.

sam: Draft quick replies:
- public reply: "Thanks! If you'd like a quick demo DM us or register: https://redwood.com/r?utm_content=public-reply"
- DM template: "Hi {name}, thanks for your interest. Would you be open to a 15-min demo? Heres my calendar: https://cal.com/redwood/demo"

kevin: Adding playbook to the SDR handbook. Also adding condition: if respondent mentions "on-prem" or "private" mark as enterprise-interest -> follow-up via AE.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule the X thread as two tweets with 2-min spacing. Use account @redwood_infer and attach hero gif + 2 follow images. Cron task will run at 10:00 PT.

rui: Metrics we care about: registrations, CVR by variant, CPL, replies & DMs, and share rate on LinkedIn. We'll run A/B on X_metric vs X_product for first 48 hours. Sam, please ensure unique utm_content values (metric_a, product_b).

maya: Comms asks: Can we get a 30-char blurb for comms email to SEs and a single-line slack snippet they can repost? Keep it numbers-forward.

sam: Blurb options:
- "New benchmark: 3x lower inference cost at 99th pct latency 4c8 Join our webinar to see results."
- "Demo + benchmarks: how we hit lower cost without sacrificing latency. RSVP now."

anya: Uploaded staging assets: s3://marketing/launch-ripple/hero_square.gif, hero_1200x627.jpg, overlay_cta_register.png. Preview: https://staging.redwoodassets/launch-ripple. Will update to CDN link after QA.

kevin: One more ops note: tag all inbound contacts with campaign=launch-ripple-05-2026 and social_variant values before HubSpot list add. Also capture referring post URL for audit.

sdr-bot: Test webhook executed successfully in staging. Sample payload includes social_variant and ref_url. Will run live test Tue 09:00 PT.

maya: Timeline recap: Sam finalize copy Mon 5pm PT, Anya final GIF Mon noon, KeviN finalize SDR playbook Tue 10am PT, Ops-bot to schedule posts Tue 10am PT. If all green we'll send comms note to SEs and partners Tue afternoon. :rocket:

rui: LGTM. I'll monitor early engagement and call for ad-boost if top-performing variant emerges.

kevin: Added checklist in the shared doc + short tag map for HubSpot fields.

maya: Thanks team 44d will pin the schedule and drop the final links when assets move to CDN."
